message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration, which serves as a magazine cover, features a centered large, silver-colored coin shown from an angled perspective. The coin is decorated with the Garuda Pancasila bird emblem, the word "INDONESIA," and the year "2017." A man in a blue business suit and black shoes, holding a brown briefcase, is depicted in mid-air above the coin. He is shown with his arms and legs splayed out in a falling or slipping motion, with his right foot touching the top edge of the coin. The background is a light, textured off-white.

Large grey text reading "TEMPO" is centered at the top, with "MAKELAR REKTOR UNIVERSITAS NEGERI" and "PARA KANDIDAT KETUA PPATK" above it. Below "TEMPO," smaller text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." A logo with "45" and "1971-2016" sits to the left. Below the center-left, bold black text reads "PROSPEK 2017 AGAR EKONOMI TAK LESU DARAH." At the bottom left, a barcode and publication details including "24-30 OKTOBER 2016" and "RP 39.500" are visible against a solid red vertical border.
